caseFindings.proposition: There are eight planets in the Solar System.
caseFindings.finding: Five selected URLs correspond to relevant passages stating eight under the IAU classification. Two changed excerpt windows were inspected by HTTP 200 retrieval; three unchanged selected excerpts reuse prior same-day inspection. No incorrect context identified for the recognized Solar System planet count.
sourceFamilies: IAU Office of Astronomy for Education
caseFindings.independenceQualification: Two JPL URLs are one family. Separately authored Timeanddate and Sky & Telescope material plus IAU education provide substantive consistency across distinct editorial/institutional families; shared underlying IAU definition is not independent empirical confirmation of a universal census. No article-level syndication observed in inspected material.

historicalCaveats.opera: Prior NMA and official Opera House sources describe the 1973 opening but are not selected by run06. Their prior review is not a review06 definitive citation result. NMA references the ABC/Opera House history project among books, so full primary-origin independence was not established.
historicalCaveats.queenElizabeth: The Opera memorial source returned HTTP 403 during review04 and remained unverified. It was not retried for review06 and is not selected by run06.
historicalCaveats.skyAndTelescope: Unchanged excerpt includes loose surprising solar system planets phrase about Pluto alongside repeated dwarf planet wording and explicit explanation it is no longer a planet; the eight-count context remains classification-specific.
